identity.name: Captain's Baton
identity.summary: An ivory tipped command baton with three brass bands.
identity.description: Adds 1 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
identity.lore: Its last order was to bring everyone home.

effects.description: Adds 1 maximum stamina, refreshed each round. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Duelist's Coin, Standard Spike into Captain's Baton.

visual.brief: An ivory tipped command baton with three brass bands.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: An ivory tipped command baton with three brass bands.
